title: Shopee Indonesia Scraper key-value store
description: Besides the platform-managed records, Shopee Indonesia Scraper writes a single SUMMARY record describing the run.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record per run: search terms used, total products scraped, pages processed, and completion time. Stored under the SUMMARY key and deliberately kept out of the dataset so it is never billed as a product.
